scope: Frozen synthetic layout-translation comparisons; every clause requires independent review.

paragraphs: Inviare il modulo per raccomandata a.r. oppure via PEC.
Non restituire il dispositivo prima della conferma scritta.
cases.expected: Send the form by registered mail with advice/acknowledgement of delivery/receipt OR PEC. Do not return the device before written confirmation. Expand a.r.; preserve both alternatives and the prohibition.

paragraphs: Il rimborso non e dovuto senza diffida scritta.
Segnalare il difetto entro 48 ore dalla scoperta a help@example.com.
cases.expected: No refund is due without written notice. Report the defect within 48 hours AFTER DISCOVERY to help@example.com. Preserve negation, condition, trigger, deadline and literal contact.

paragraphs: Return order TX-417 within 14 working days after written confirmation.
Do not return it without consent. Send notice by email or registered mail.
cases.expected: Return TX-417 within 14 WORKING days AFTER WRITTEN confirmation. Do not return without consent. Notice may use email OR registered mail. Preserve all conditions and alternatives, without adding proof-of-receipt requirements.

paragraphs: Store the pump between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius. Do not freeze it.
If frost is observed, quarantine the pump; do not install it.
cases.expected: Store between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius; do not freeze. IF frost is observed, quarantine the pump and do not install. Preserve both prohibitions and the condition.
